levers.name: terminal on the disclosed 17.84-year life; growth stored as a real rate
levers.why: the terminal was the retired reinvestment identity, implying a 40.0-year replacement cycle against a weighted useful life of 17.84 the accounts disclose — the PEGGED-MARKET side, where 1/g runs long and under-charges THIS LEVER READ 4.39 UNTIL 4 SEPTEMBER 2026 AND WAS WRONG: it handed the sanctioned construction a profit figure, a depreciation charge and a working-capital balance ALL already grown by (1+g), which the construction grows again, overstating the terminal by exactly (1+g) — 2.50% here. On a name whose terminal is 96% of enterprise value that is nearly the whole error.
levers.evidence: FY2025 note 4 class lives weighted by note 5 gross cost; aircraft and engines are 87.4% of the depreciable base at a single disclosed 20 years

levers.name: the typed 45/20/20/15 blend retired; normalised earnings excluded
levers.why: weights that had never cleared an out-of-sample test, and normalised earnings power is not a permitted lens for an airline at all — it carried a fifth of the weight and read 3.43 against a cash-flow 4.82
levers.evidence: an airline's reported earnings in any one year are an accident of the fuel curve, the delivery schedule and the load factor
